notes.title: Some news on Sol Cesto
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]Chariospirale and I wanted to give you some news about Sol Cesto. After delivering an optimization update and the update that introduced the flute (and some secrets), we’re now working on the September update.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790993/27f678377f438efd44ea1a6d9a5f47be2df1033f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This update will bring a brand-new biome, the 4th one! Of course, this biome will come with its own monsters, traps, and environmental effects. And watch out, it’s going to be a bit tougher than the previous ones… Antoine is also working on a track that should set a, let’s say, warm atmosphere 🔥🔥🔥[/p][p][/p][p]There will also be a few new items, like the fireball and the egg, as well as a new character hidden somewhere in the underground. In short, plenty of new things to further enrich your Sol Cesto experience, starting in September.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790993/c34b67ee8161f74e3b53dddeaaf575bdb50447a4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Sorry about the roadmap: every time we want to update it with Chariospirale, we realize we want to change our plans. We carefully read your feedback, and it really shakes up the way we deliver updates. But we’ll try to use Steam News more often to keep you informed![/p][p][/p][p]Anyway, thank you all so much for your patience and support. It means a lot to us that so many of you enjoy playing Sol Cesto 🌞[/p][p][/p][p]THANK YOU, and see you soon![/p][p][/p][p]Géraud and Chariospirale. [/p]

notes.title: Content update #1 out now!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone!
[/p][p]Finally, here's the first content update for Sol Cesto. This will be the smallest content update, mainly because the previous patch was released less than 20 days ago. But this one adds an element we wanted to have in the game from the start: the flute. You’ll have to play a bit to find it and uncover its secrets. We won’t spoil anything, so here’s the list of changes included in this update:[/p][list][*][p]The flute, with its different pieces to collect[/p][/*][*][p]A few melodies with magical effects, hidden in different places[/p][/*][*][p]One small extra secret[/p][/*][*][p]Balancing adjustments to the spawn rate of certain items[/p][/*][*][p]Balancing changes to the fairy, who now only revives half of the hero’s health[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes for numerous minor bugs (we know there are still some left, we’re working on it!)
[/p][/*][/list][p]As for what’s next, Chariospirale and I are currently discussing it. We know what we want to add to the game, but your feedback is making us rethink the order in which we’ll release things! We’d like the next update to be a big one, but first we need to be sure what we can include before updating the roadmap. Sorry about that! But as you’ve seen, less than a month passed between the last update and this one, so we’re actively working on the game and promise great things to come 🌞
[/p][p]Thanks for your patience, and see you very soon for more adventures in the depths of Sol Cesto.[/p][p]
Géraud & Chariospirale[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2738490/Sol_Cesto/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone!  
 
Following our latest update, some bugs went through our nets and made it to the live version! This hotfix is here to correct them. 
Thanks once again for your patience, reporting the bugs, and in general for all your feedback, it is really appreciated! 

Please find the patchnote below:

notes.title: Sol Cesto - Corrective patch + Steam Cloud! - v0.51.04
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone! First of all, we wanted to thank you all for the warm welcome you've given to Sol Cesto![/p][p]It's been more than a month that the game is out, and the last build is actually 1 month old! We wanted to thank you so much for your patience.  Chariospirale and I put in a ton of work to release [i]Sol Cesto[/i] in early access, and we needed a bit of time to recover. The success of the game was totally unexpected, and your support gave us a huge boost of energy, thank you so much![/p][p]After a short break, I jumped back in to fix as many bugs as I could and to optimize the game over the past few weeks. And here it is, a fresh new update with lots of fixes, and most importantly, smoother performance across both PC and Steam Deck![/p][p]We’ll keep squashing bugs throughout early access, but now Chariospirale and I are focusing on creating new content so we can bring you regular updates. The next one should arrive in a few weeks, around mid-July. It’ll be the smallest content update, but I think it’s going to surprise you. We’ll also be sharing a clearer roadmap in the coming weeks 🌞[/p][p]Thanks again for all your patience, your kind words, your reviews, and the amazing fan art of [i]Sol Cesto[/i]. It gives us so much motivation to keep making the best game we possibly can![/p][p]See you soon,
[/p][p]Géraud & Chariospirale
[/p][p] You can have a look to the complete patchnote below. But before that, I've got some news to tell you: [/p][p]We're activating Steam Cloud! But it comes with some warnings:[/p][p][b][u]Even though we're doing our best so the activation of Steam Cloud is as seamless as possible on your side, please read what follows:[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p]Your save is being uploaded in the Steam Cloud when you're closing the game. This means that there is a possibility, if you launch the game from a computer you've never launched Sol Cesto before, that your most advanced save isn't yet on the Cloud, then pushing the one from this "new device". To avoid this, open and close the game on the device you've the most advanced on first. If you can't, Steam should still see that there's a conflict between local and cloud saves and ask you to choose which save you want to keep, but this trick should "force" Steam Cloud to download the one you want.[/p][p][b]Can I get my PC save on my Steamdeck?[/b][/p][p]Yes you can, [b]but do note[/b] that for your save to be clouded, you'd have to play the Proton version of the game. This is the default version Steam uses to launch the game; it means that if you didn't force anything in the Compatibility tab (in your Library > Game Properties > Force Compatibility to Linux runtime) you shouldn't have to do anything, and Steam Cloud should work right away[/p][p][u]If you play via Linux runtime environment on your Steamdeck:[/u][/p][p]We strongly advise that you use the Proton version. Cloud Saves won't work on the Linux version. I've tried my best to make it work but couldn't.[/p][p]It means, if you go to the Proton version from the Linux Runtime one, that you will lose all your current progression.  We're very sorry about that, but we did not find any other solution. We'd rather have you make this switch right now early in Sol Cesto's Early Access rather than later, when the content lost will be higher. While there is a native Linux Version of this 0.51.04 version, if we cannot find a way to make Cloud Saves work on native Linux version, we might drop the support of native Linux versions (the vast majority of you should already be playing via Proton versions, unless you changed compatibility settings, as stated before).[/p][p]If our information is correct, Linux distributions that do not support proton are pretty rare, so this shouldn't impact a lot of people, and the problems we face are complex, thus this decision might be taken. If some of you wouldn't be able to play anymore if we drop the native Linux version support, please tell us on Discord or on the Forums and explain us why so we can figure out solutions! If we do take this decision, of course you'll be informed, and it won't make any difference about the Steamdeck version; we'll ensure the game is supported on Steamdeck, even if it is via Proton. Feel free to give us feedback on this new version that should have performance improvements! [/p][p]Lastly, [b]just in case, you can backup your saves on your computer[/b]. [/p][p]To do so, press Windows + R on your keyboard, then in the window that opened paste this:[/p][p]"%APPDATA%/../local" [/p][p]In the folder that opened, there should be a "Sol Cesto" folder. Make a .zip of this file. Should you encounter any problem, you can replace the folder with the one you zipped just here. If there's any issues, having this folder somewhere will help us restore your save if you ever have an issue.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Alright, now please find the full patchnote below:[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Overall performance improvements, on PC and Steamdeck versions[/p][/*][*][p]Light rebalancing of the level design on some stages[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalancing of the apparition rate of some teeth (namely those with gold multiplicator)[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalancing of the fairy apparition rate, which now have way less chance to drop twice in a single run[/p][/*][*][p]Overall bugfixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed Switch and Magicien Monsters not activating in some circumstances[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some teeth effects that weren't activating in some circumstances[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Wizard power that was leading to a softlock in some circumstances[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue when droping below -100% attraction on a room type would prevent from clicking on them [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Hive monsters that were spawning too many bees[/p][/*][*][p]Overall smaller bugfixes, audio bugfixes [/p][/*][*][p]Some teeth weren't activating correctly in certain situations[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Thanks again everyone, and we'll keep you posted on what's next as soon as possible![/p]

notes.title: Sol Cesto Hotfix - 0.48.09
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyoooone![/h3]

First of all and since it's the very first Steam news since launch, we want to thank you all for playing Sol Cesto! You've welcomed the game with a lot of kind messages, both in the forum and the reviews, and it truly warms our hearts. 
Talking about reviews, a lot of you have been positively reviewing the game, and given how important it is, we wanted to thank you again! And if you havn't yet, feel free to do it!

Lastly, thanks for reporting all the issues you've had, and for giving your opinions on a lot of things in Sol Cesto. It is really precious for us both to get the game as stable as possible, but also having new and fresh eyes and hands on the game, which is always really important

We're rolling out this first patch to deal with the two most important things yet : Softlocking during Boss transition, and the very long freeze on the Smith's screen.
There's also been other small changes that you can find in the full patchnote below

[h3]Now what's next?[/h3]
About the sequence of the Early Access overall, you can check the Roadmap on the Store page. It is not too precise yet because we're yet to confirm the update schedules. We've got plans, but we want to be sure it's the best before commuinicating. We will definitely as soon as it's ready!

About the short term though, I can tell you what we're working on right now :
Of course, Bugfixes. Please keep the reports coming either on Discord or in the Steam forums if you face any issue! It can always help us finding out what's happenning, and most importantly, why
The second thing is fixing the Steamdeck slowdowns that can happen. Even if it's still playable, we don't want to say the game is Steamdeck ready with those slowdowns.
In the mean time, we'll ready up and activate the Cloud Saves for the game. The saves being a critical matter, please understant that we'll test them thoroughly and that it might take a bit of time. But all of this is planned for the next few weeks!

Thanks again everyone for playing Sol Cesto, and please find the full patchnote for this hotfix below :

[h2]Sol Cesto Hotfix - 0.48.09 [/h2]
[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the player was locked in the transition between phase 1 and phase 2 of the boss.
[*] Fixed a bug where the screen was freezing for a long time on the Smith's screen
[*] Fixed a variety of audio issues
[*] Fixed some localization issues
[/list]
[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*] 1st, 2nd and 3rd biomes are a bit longer
[*] 3rd Biome's boss is now a bit harder to beat
[/list]

notes.title: New demo update - new playable character, new monsters and more!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’ve just released a cool new update for the Sol Cesto demo, and we can't wait for you to check it out! 

[b]Here’s what’s new:
[/b][list]
[*][b]1 new character to unlock[/b]: The Warrior, with a unique movement ability and her own stats and items.
[*][b]3 new special monsters[/b]: The Treasure-stealing Magician, the Musician who boosts his monster pals, and the Demon Rabbit who switches between magic and strength.
[*][b]2 new items from the Merchant[/b]: The Ice Cube weakens all monsters on screen, while the Wrench destroys any traps blocking your way.
[*][b]2 new items from the Fountain[/b]: The Fairy and the Piece of Trash.

notes.title: Demo Update - Adding languages!

Hello everyone!

We're making a quick news to tell you that we're adding quite a few languages to the demo from Sol Cesto! It might be the right time to get on the train, wherever you're from! We had French and English in the game, but here's the new full list of all languages included :

French, English, Spanish, German, Polish, Italien, Turkish, Russian, Hungarian, Thai, Korean, Japanese, Ukrainian, Brazilian Portuguese, Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, Traditionnal chinese and Czech. So to get some content in this news more that just this list, I'd figure I could say thanks in every language listed.
As I obviously do not talk all those languages, you can guess I'll be using an automated translation, so forgive me if something isn't really the way you'd say thanks! (And comment so I can learn :D)

Merci, Thanks, Gracias, Danke, Dziękuję, Grazie, Teşekkürler, Спасибо, Köszönöm, ขอบคุณ, 감사합니다, ありがとう, Дякую, Obrigado, 谢谢, 謝謝, Děkuji.

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
The Sol Cesto demo has been updated and now includes the following content:

[list][*] New monster animations: monsters now have a scared state (if they are weak) or aggressive state.
[*] New interface that indicates damage received on each tile when hovering over a line. No need to calculate in your head anymore.
[*] New cursed teeth with conditional curse effects. For example: landing on a chest weakens adjacent monsters.
[*] Cursed teeth that influence percentages have been rebalanced and are more precise: you can modify your attraction to magical, physical monsters, traps, etc.
[*] There are more floors than before.
[*] Balancing of the hero's starting stats and monster power.[/list]

Enjoy!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2738490/Sol_Cesto/

To provide feedback on the demo, [url=https://discord.gg/Edmx5tMt8U]join us on Discord[/url].
